<h2 class="post-box-title"><a href="https://www.caninejournal.com/essential-oils-for-dogs/" rel="bookmark">Doggy Day Spa: Essential Oils For Dogs</a></h2>
<p class="post-meta">
<span class="post-meta-author"><i class="fa fa-user"></i><a href="https://www.caninejournal.com/author/kimberly-alt/" title="">Kimberly Alt </a></span>
<span class="tie-date"><i class="fa fa-clock-o"></i>Updated: October 18, 2019</span> <span class="post-cats"><i class="fa fa-folder"></i><a href="https://www.caninejournal.com/category/health/" rel="category tag">Dog Health</a></span>
<span class="post-comments"><i class="fa fa-comments"></i><a href="https://www.caninejournal.com/essential-oils-for-dogs/#comments">21</a></span>
</p>
<div class="post-thumbnail">
<a href="https://www.caninejournal.com/essential-oils-for-dogs/" rel="bookmark">
<img alt="Essential Oils For Dogs" class="attachment-tie-large size-tie-large wp-post-image" height="200" sizes="(max-width: 325px) 100vw, 325px" src="https://www.caninejournal.com/wp-content/uploads/essential-oils-for-dogs.jpg" srcset="https://www.caninejournal.com/wp-content/uploads/essential-oils-for-dogs.jpg 325w, https://www.caninejournal.com/wp-content/uploads/essential-oils-for-dogs-110x68.jpg 110w, https://www.caninejournal.com/wp-content/uploads/essential-oils-for-dogs-310x191.jpg 310w" width="325"/> <span class="fa overlay-icon"></span>
</a>
</div><!-- post-thumbnail /-->
<div class="entry">
<div class="excerpt">
<p>Ahhh, ode de toilet is the scent of choice among canines everywhere. But, are essential oils safe for dogs? Not all. So it’s important to do your research before trying aromatherapy on your pup. Some of the oils we discuss in this article can help with flea infestations, arthritis and more…</p>
</div>
